_note: Ratchet cap for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings. Lower it whenever a stale closure is fixed; never raise it to make the build pass -- each unit is a callback that can capture a stale sessionToken and read or write the wrong store (item 69). Set to 5 after item 70 fixed swapSessionToken's captured picker_ticket (12 -> 7 -> 5). Lowered to 4 when Tooltip.tsx's portal clamp effect gained its missing `align` dependency. Lowered to 3 on 2026-10-12 by two changes: TableManagementScreen.tsx's floor-plan sync effect listed an EMPTY deps array, so the tabs:changed handler kept the mount-time sessionToken and section -- a store switch followed by any terminal's save reloaded the PREVIOUS store's floor plan (a real store-scoping defect, not cosmetic); and WorkspaceKdsSettings.tsx carried a stale eslint-disable whose violation the deps fix had already removed. The 3 that remain are individually assessed as correct-as-written or cosmetic: StaffLoginScreen.tsx:216 and :251 (normalizeCashier), and CreditFacilityCard.tsx:154 (currency).
